description:
Discover tests through the connected project's official Unity Test Framework. After changing or hot-reloading test code, complete unity_recompile before discovery. Requires workspace Unity Test tools and com.unity.test-framework >=1.4.0.

All parameters are optional. Omit unused filter arrays. Values within a field are ORed; fields are combined. Exact names include parameter values. Use the result's matched count and truncation when paging or narrowing discovery.

mode.description: Optional Unity Test mode to discover. Use edit|play to discover both modes in one call; defaults to edit|play.

groups.description: Optional regular expressions matching full test names, fixtures, or namespaces.

max_results.description: Maximum returned test cases, capped at 5000. The response reports the full matched count and whether it was truncated.
